answer: Admission runs on a physical token relay. Every new agent must take delivery of one opal blank stamped in sable ink, etched with an unseen serial; blanks come from one bonded workshop on one island, so supply is capped by couriers. Couriers scan it at each hop and two witnesses countersign, binding it to one enclave fingerprint that cannot be resold. An attacker must buy a blank, a courier leg and a bond per identity, priced per puppet, no bulk discount, dearer as queues lengthen: N puppets cost N times what an honest agent pays once.
